english.title: Take action falling within section 62(3)(a) to (d) re apparatus contravening restriction order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) took action in contravention of section 62(5) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 relating to the

(A)_[manufacture of apparatus falling within section 62(3)(a)]_
(B)_[sale or offering for sale of apparatus falling within section 62(3)(b)]_
(C)_[letting on hire or offering to let on hire of apparatus falling within section 62(3)(c)]_
(D)_[indication of a willingness to sell or to let on hire apparatus falling within section 62(3)(d)]_

of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(1)(a) and (3) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 107 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(ii) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(iii) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed Penalty charge of £100-00p (in force from 01/10/2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
